lesson.title: Wonder Inspires Action
lesson.topic: How maintaining a sense of wonder about the world can drive curiosity, exploration and personal growth.
lesson.steelman: Can the feeling of genuine wonder be harnessed as an effective tool for daily motivation?
lesson.example: The story of Galileo using his wonder about celestial bodies to challenge established astronomical beliefs.

rationale: Encourages learners to see the practical benefits of maintaining a sense of wonder.
